plugin.name: mlk
plugin.description:
The MLk plugin implements KOERI's local magnitude calculation formulas. It provides two different calculation methods based on epicentral distance:
For distances ≤ 200 km: MLk = Log10A - (-1.118-0.0647Δ+0.00071Δ²-3.39x10⁻⁶Δ³+5.71x10⁻⁹Δ⁴)
For distances > 200 km: MLk = Log10A + 0.0082Δ - 5.9628x10⁻⁶Δ² + 2.1173
where Δ is the epicentral distance in kilometers and A is the zero-to-peak Wood-Anderson amplitude in millimeters.

binding.name: mlk
binding.description: Configuration options for the KOERI local magnitude (MLk) calculation.

parameter.name: minSNR
parameter.description: Minimum signal-to-noise ratio for accepting an MLk magnitude. Magnitudes with SNR below this threshold will be flagged as having failed quality control but will still be included in processing.

parameter.name: maxDist
parameter.description: Maximum epicentral distance for computing MLk amplitudes. Stations beyond this distance will not be used.

parameter.name: filter
parameter.description: Optional filter to apply to waveform data before amplitude measurement. If not specified, no filtering will be applied. Example: "BW(3,0.5,12)"
